candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - where to view LiDAR data
verified_facts: EA states the LiDAR WMS Preview is an image of the data.
The preview image cannot be queried.
Coverage Metadata WMS Preview shows raster extents rather than the elevation data itself.
semantic_limits: A WMS image, colour, hillshade or footprint cannot be used as a parcel elevation sample or as proof of the exact raster value.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Removal of Esri Image Services / WCS replacement
verified_facts: EA replaced proprietary Esri Image services with WCS and WMS open-standard services.
EA describes WMS as a summarised view of elevation data and WCS as providing elevation/raw pixel data.
WCS is available for LiDAR Composite elevation models and is supported using OGC WCS 2.0.1.
Composite service endpoints were changed to persistent names without annual release suffixes for future updates.
semantic_limits: A persistent endpoint points to the current service and does not prove byte identity with a historical SHA-bound raster; exact dataset/version provenance remains required.
